subject: general
question: After the ________ of Hakim Mirza, Kabul was annexed by Akbar and given to Raja Man Singh as ‘jagir’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**death**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hakim Mirza, also known as Mirza Muhammad Hakim, was the ruler of Kabul and a half-brother of Mughal Emperor Akbar.
 
• After his death in 1585, Akbar annexed Kabul into the Mughal Empire.
 
• Kabul was subsequently given to Raja Man Singh as a 'jagir' by Akbar.
 
• This consolidation helped Akbar strengthen his control over the north-western frontier of his empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar the Great:**

 
 
• Akbar, the third Mughal Emperor, reigned from 1556 to 1605.
 
• He is known for his military conquests, administrative innovations, and efforts to foster religious tolerance.
 
• Akbar's reign significantly expanded the Mughal Empire and is often referred to as a golden age in Indian history.
 
 
 
• **Raja Man Singh:**
 
 
• Raja Man Singh was a prominent general in Akbar’s court and one of his Navaratnas (nine gems).
 
• He played a crucial role in several military campaigns, including those in Bengal, Bihar, and Kabul.
 
 
 
• **Kabul:**
 
 
• Kabul was an important strategic location for the Mughal Empire, serving as a gateway to Central Asia.
 
• The region was known for its economic and cultural significance during the Mughal period.
 
 
 
• **Jagir:**
 
 
• A 'jagir' was a type of land grant given by the Mughal Emperor to his nobles and officials in lieu of a salary.
 
• The holder of a jagir, known as a jagirdar, was responsible for the administration and revenue collection of the area.
